dishes.title: Shepherd's Pie
dishes.description: Lamb mince in rich gravy under a fluffy mash top.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel and boil the potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes until soft.
Brown the lamb mince in a pan, then add the chopped onion and diced carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree, Worcestershire sauce, crumbled stock cube and 100 ml water per serving. Simmer 15 minutes, then add the peas.
Mash the potatoes with the butter and milk and season well.
Spoon the mince into a dish, top with mash and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden. The filling should reach 75°C.

dishes.title: Cottage Pie
dishes.description: The beef version of shepherd's pie, topped with cheesy mash.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil the peeled potatoes until soft.
Brown the beef with chopped onion and diced carrot.
Make the gravy granules up with 120 ml boiling water per serving and stir into the beef. Simmer 10 minutes.
Mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
Top the beef with mash and grated cheddar and bake 25 minutes until bubbling. The filling should reach 75°C.

dishes.title: Oven Fish and Chips
dishes.description: Crispy breaded fish with oven chips and mushy peas.
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and bake the chips according to the pack.
Blitz or crumble the bread into crumbs. Dust the fish in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press in crumbs.
Put the fish on an oiled tray and bake 15 to 18 minutes until it flakes and reaches 63°C inside.
Warm the mushy peas and serve with the fish, chips and lemon wedges.

dishes.title: Bangers and Mash
dishes.description: Sausages with creamy mash and onion gravy.
instructions: Grill or oven-bake the sausages for 20 to 25 minutes, turning, until cooked through to 75°C.
Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes, then mash with butter and milk.
Slowly fry the sliced onion in a little butter until soft and golden, then add gravy granules made up with 120 ml boiling water per serving.
Cook the peas and serve everything with the onion gravy.

dishes.title: Full English Breakfast
dishes.description: Bacon, sausage, egg, beans, mushrooms and toast.
instructions: Grill the sausages for about 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through to 75°C.
Add the bacon, halved tomatoes and black pudding to the grill for the last 8 minutes.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in a little oil, then fry the eggs.
Warm the beans, toast the bread and serve everything together.

dishes.title: Cheesy Beans on Toast
dishes.description: A quick, cheap British favourite.
instructions: Warm the beans in a pan for 4 to 5 minutes.
Toast and butter the bread.
Pour the beans over the toast and top with grated cheddar.

dishes.title: Buttered Crumpets with Honey
dishes.description: Toasted crumpets with butter and honey.
instructions: Toast the crumpets until crisp on top.
Spread with butter while hot and drizzle with honey.

dishes.title: Porridge with Banana
dishes.description: Creamy oat porridge with banana and honey.
instructions: Simmer the oats and milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Top with sliced banana and honey.

dishes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
dishes.description: Britain's favourite curry, mild and creamy.
instructions: Mix the diced chicken with yogurt and half the curry powder.
Fry the chopped onion in oil for 8 minutes, add garlic, ginger and remaining curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the cream. Meanwhile cook the rice and serve together.

dishes.title: Sunday Roast Chicken
dishes.description: Roast chicken with roast potatoes, carrots and gravy.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Roast the chicken about 20 minutes per 500 g plus 20 minutes, until the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Parboil chunks of potato for 8 minutes, shake, then roast in hot oil for 50 minutes.
Roast the carrots and parsnips with a little oil for 35 minutes.
Rest the chicken 10 minutes, make the gravy and heat the Yorkshire puddings.
Carve and serve.

dishes.title: Toad in the Hole
dishes.description: Sausages baked in a puffy Yorkshire batter.
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Brown the sausages in a tin with the oil in the oven for 10 minutes.
Pour the batter around the sausages and bake 25 to 30 minutes without opening the door, until risen and golden and the sausages reach 75°C.
Serve with onion gravy.

dishes.title: Jacket Potato with Beans and Cheese
dishes.description: Crispy baked potato with beans and cheddar.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Prick the potato and bake 60 minutes (or microwave 8 minutes, then bake 15).
Warm the beans.
Split the potato, add butter, beans and grated cheese.

dishes.title: Ham and Cheese Toastie
dishes.description: Golden grilled sandwich.
instructions: Butter the outsides of the bread.
Fill with ham, grated cheese and pickle.
Fry in a dry pan 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.

dishes.title: Ploughman's Lunch
dishes.description: Cheese, ham, pickle, apple and crusty bread.
instructions: Slice the cheese, apple and bread.
Arrange on a board with the ham, pork pie, pickle and lettuce.

dishes.title: Lancashire Hotpot
dishes.description: Lamb and onion stew under crispy sliced potatoes.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Brown the lamb and layer it in a dish with sliced onion and carrot.
Pour over stock made with 150 ml water per serving and the Worcestershire sauce.
Cover with thinly sliced potatoes in overlapping rows and dot with butter.
Cover and bake 90 minutes, then uncover for 30 minutes to crisp the top. The lamb should reach 75°C.

dishes.title: Macaroni Cheese
dishes.description: Baked pasta in a cheddar sauce.
instructions: Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the pack says and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Add mustard and most of the cheese.
Mix the sauce with the pasta, top with the remaining cheese and grill or bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.

dishes.title: Kedgeree
dishes.description: Smoked haddock, curried rice and egg.
instructions: Poach the haddock in water for 8 minutes until it flakes and reaches 63°C. Flake it.
Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Fry the onion in butter, add curry powder, then the rice and 2 times its volume of the fish water. Simmer 12 minutes, adding peas at the end.
Fold in the fish, top with quartered eggs and parsley.

dishes.title: Steak and Onion Pie Bake
dishes.description: Steak and onion in gravy topped with mash crust.
instructions: Toss the beef in flour and brown it in a casserole.
Add onion, diced swede and gravy made with 200 ml water per serving. Cover and cook at 160°C for 75 minutes until tender.
Top with mash made from the potatoes and butter and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes. The filling should reach 75°C.

dishes.title: Leek and Potato Soup
dishes.description: Silky, thrifty soup with crusty bread.
instructions: Soften the sliced leeks and onion in butter for 8 minutes.
Add diced potato and stock made with 250 ml water per serving. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the milk, season and serve with bread.

dishes.title: Gammon, Egg and Chips
dishes.description: Pub classic with pineapple optional.
instructions: Bake the chips according to the pack.
Grill the gammon steaks 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked to 70°C.
Fry the eggs and cook the peas. Serve together.

dishes.title: Beef Stew with Dumplings
dishes.description: Slow-cooked beef with fluffy suet dumplings.
instructions: Brown the beef, then add the onion, carrot and swede.
Add tomato puree and stock made with 250 ml water per serving. Cover and simmer gently 2 hours.
Mix the flour and suet with enough cold water to make a soft dough and roll into small balls.
Sit the dumplings on the stew, cover and cook 20 minutes more until risen. The beef should reach 75°C.

dishes.title: Fish Finger Sandwich
dishes.description: Crispy fish fingers in soft bread with mayo.
instructions: Grill or bake the fish fingers 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until piping hot.
Spread the bread with mayo, add lettuce and fish fingers.

dishes.title: Chicken and Leek Pie
dishes.description: Creamy chicken and leek under a mash or pastry lid.
instructions: Fry diced chicken in butter until browned, add the sliced leeks and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in flour, then milk and stock made with 100 ml water per serving. Simmer 10 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Top with mashed potato and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

dishes.title: Bubble and Squeak
dishes.description: Crispy fried potato and cabbage cakes with eggs.
instructions: Boil and roughly mash the potatoes (or use leftovers). Shred and cook the cabbage for 4 minutes.
Mix with fried onion, then press into a hot buttered pan.
Fry 5 minutes per side until crisp. Serve with a fried egg.

dishes.title: Roast Vegetable Pasta Bake
dishes.description: Courgette, peppers and tomato pasta with melted mozzarella.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the chopped vegetables in oil for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta and drain.
Mix pasta, vegetables, passata and herbs in a dish, top with torn mozzarella and bake 15 minutes.

dishes.title: Cream Tea Scones
dishes.description: Scones with jam and clotted cream.
instructions: Warm the scones for 5 minutes at 180°C if you like.
Split and spread with jam and clotted cream. Serve with tea.

dishes.title: Quorn Chilli
dishes.description: Meat-free chilli with kidney beans and rice.
instructions: Fry the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the mince, beans and tomatoes. Simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with cooked rice.
